test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eight friends Rahul, Ram, Ramesh, Sohan, Sahil, Anil, Sonu and Monu are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Monu is to immediate right of Sahil. Sonu is third to the left of Sahil. Ram is third to the right of Anil. Sohan is second to the right of Monu. Who is fourth to the right of Monu?
solution: **Given :** Eight friends Rahul, Ram, Ramesh, Sohan, Sahil, Anil, Sonu and Monu are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. **Explanation : ** 1) Monu is to immediate right of Sahil. 2) Sohan is second to the right of Monu.
